context_for_next_testing_agent: GettingStartedSection component on /tutorials page works correctly. 16 language buttons render with proper data-testid attributes. Video playback fails because video files have moov atom at end of file - need to re-encode with ffmpeg -movflags +faststart. Backend API /api/tutorials/video-file/{filename} returns videos correctly with proper CORS headers.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: MP4 video files have moov atom (metadata) at position 14656281 (end of ~14.6MB file). Browsers need moov atom at the beginning for progressive/streaming playback. Without faststart, browser must download entire file before parsing metadata.
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Re-encode all 16 video files with: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -c copy -movflags +faststart output.mp4. This moves moov atom to beginning without re-encoding video/audio streams.
